@DrSepinwall @TiJanBosal Very helpful exchange, especially because of the contradiction we face re Haiti's Francophile élite seeming both "anti-racist" globally & "racist" locally.  The net effect of "racism" wins though. What good can #BlackLivesMatter do while so many Black lives @ home are sacrificed?
